thread:
maya: Quick sync — postlaunch iteration for the streaming embeddings roll. Need to pick bug hotlist vs enhancements for the next 2-week mini-wave.
alejandro: We have capacity for 3 medium+ bugs if we freeze feature work. PR blocking: `infra/kv-cache` merge (PR #342) — without it p99 token spike persists.
sasha: I can take the log-rotation bug and the prompt-truncation one. :+1: Which customer-facing regressions are highest priority?
tess: Support flags 2 paying customers hitting embed mismatch — one on Dedicated prod, one on Hosted. Both prefer fixes over new UX.
jon: Data: embed error rate spike correlates with cache evictions at 9pm UTC. Heatmap coming in a sec.
maya: Decision options: A) Prioritize 3 bugs (freeze features); B) 2 bugs + 1 polishing enhancement; C) push some to next wave and do hotfixes only. Thoughts?
alejandro: Prefer A for reliability. Recommend small mitigation roll first: rollback quantization change for affected models, then queue the enhancement.
sasha: Agree A. Quick checklist for this sprint:
```
- revert quant change (eng)
- deploy canary to eu-west (ops)
- test embed signatures on Dedicated (qa)
- notify CS + customers (prod)
```
tess: @maya can you confirm comms cadence? We'll need SLO exemptions + one-off credits.
maya: I'll draft customer note and post to CS channel by EOD. Also set canary window: 2h, monitor p99. If stable, promote.
release-bot: deploy triggered: canary/revert-quant - started by alejandro. CI: passed, rolling to eu-west.
alejandro: Thanks. I'll assign owners: sasha -> prompt truncation, me -> revert + infra PR, jon -> telemetry dashboard. Backlog: we'll groom remaining enhancements Wed.
maya: Perfect. Closing decision: go with option A. Owners assigned. Follow-up sync Wednesday 10:30am PT. :white_check_mark:
